lines.**第一階段：完成 Token 成本試算。** 我先把流程拆成兩段：地端用兩組: **Phase 1: the token cost estimate.** I split the flow in two: on premises, two OCR models read the documents and an SLM checks inconsistencies; a cloud LLM processes the results. OCR work is measured in pages, not tokens: a dense table page and a one-line title differ ten times in tokens but take similar scan time. In the cloud, each case uses 11,250 input and 2,500 output tokens. With a GPT5.5 price assumption ($2.5 input / $15 output), that is about NT$1.92 per case. Multiplied by the growing volume (14,999, 16,649, and 18,480 cases per month in years 1 to 3), it gives the 3-year token cost.
lines.**第一階段：完成上線前檢核的 Survey。** 原則是監理的語言，檢查需要具: **Phase 1: the pre-launch check survey.** Principles are the regulator's language; a check needs concrete objects. I split it into three layers: **documents** (was the process followed, are records kept, who approved), **AI output** (is it correct and fair, does it leak data, can it explain itself), and **AI behavior** (what data it read, what it changed, whether it exceeded its permissions). Existing policies covered only the first layer. The second and third were empty.

lines.**第一階段：建立通話量與時段假設。** Token 看起來是最直覺的單位，但它: **Phase 1: call volume and time-window assumptions.** Tokens look like the obvious unit, but they do not fit speech: in the same 3-minute call, fast and slow speakers can differ almost two times in tokens, while GPU time is about the same. So STT is measured in minutes and the SLM in tokens, multiplied separately and then added. From 43,000 calls per month, I placed the workload in the business-hour peak: it must answer in real time and cannot move to off-peak like a batch job.
lines.**第一階段：建置 Qdrant 向量資料庫。** 我們一開始考慮過直接 fin: **Phase 1: build the Qdrant vector database.** We first considered fine-tuning a model, but the manuals change often and retraining each time costs too much. RAG separates the knowledge base from the model: when a document changes, only its embeddings are rebuilt. I compared Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, and Qdrant, and chose Qdrant: it runs self-hosted on Docker so data stays inside the company, it supports filtering for category queries, and it performs well at medium data volume.
lines.**第一階段：把 GPU 拆成空間和時間。** 我用一棟大樓來說明算力中心：樓板: **Phase 1: split GPUs into space and time.** I explain the GPU pool as a building: floor area decides how many AI models can move in; operating hours decide how many Agents can be served. Space is GPU memory: it holds models, is never given back, and is a fixed cost. Time is GPU compute: it runs requests, is reused, and is a variable cost. The bank's pool is 5 RTX PRO 6000 cards at 96 GB each: 480 GB and 432,000 card-seconds per day.

lines.**第二階段：建立三套成本模型與一套效益模型。** 容量模型算出每個 Agent: **Phase 2: three cost models and one benefit model.** The capacity model gives the memory and card-seconds each Agent's on-premises parts need. The benefit model is volume × improvement per unit × value per unit. One key point in the space model: KV cache memory depends on how many requests run at the same time, not on how many run in a day. So whether to buy more GPUs depends on peak concurrent use.

lines.**第四階段：用同一把尺比較兩個方案。** 只看 XecGuard 自己的成績不: **Phase 4: one scorecard for both options.** XecGuard's own score was not enough. On a 9-dimension AI Safety scorecard (protection, false blocks, integration, governance evidence, cost, and more), I compared it side by side with the platform's built-in guardrail. The built-in guardrail already blocked every attack. Another layer could not raise the block rate, but would add false blocks, integration work, and license cost. So I made the adoption proposal.
lines.**第四階段：確認 GPU 配置。** 我以月登入量推估第 1 到 3 年的用量: **Phase 4: confirm the GPU allocation.** I forecast usage for years 1 to 3 from monthly logins. Its SLM runs all day, so its card-seconds fall in both the peak and off-peak windows. The allocation was confirmed at 2 production GPUs and 1 test GPU.
lines.**貸款助理不需要任何 GPU：它在地端只用 CPU 做資料脫敏，成本會全部落在: **The Loan Assistant needs no GPU: on premises it uses only CPUs for data masking, so all of its cost is in cloud tokens.** The monthly volume is still pending from the business unit, so TCO and ROI cannot be calculated yet.
lines.**集團 AI 治理報告的審查，從人工逐份判讀，變成系統先完成判定、驗算與勾稽，: **Review of group AI governance reports moved from reading each report by hand to the system checking, recalculating, and cross-checking first, then passing results to a reviewer.** CI/CD deployment made development faster and the system more stable.
lines.- 6 個 LLM 構面評分，全部在 1% 水準下顯著。: - All 6 LLM dimension scores are significant at the 1% level.
lines.- Dify 完成 34 項測試設計與 PoC 報告。: - Dify: 34 test items designed and a PoC report delivered.
lines.- PoC 留下一套版本化題庫與逐題行為矩陣，之後每一個 Agent 都能用同一: - The PoC left a versioned test set and a case-by-case behavior matrix, so every future Agent can be checked with the same ruler.
lines.- XecGuard 擋下 98.3% 的紅隊攻擊題，但 30 題正常提問中誤擋: - XecGuard blocked 98.3% of the red-team attacks, but also blocked 20 of 30 normal questions, and added about 0.8 seconds per check.
lines.- 兩個平台用同一張金控的 9 大類 42 項評分表比較，選型決策有了可以並排比: - Both platforms were scored on the holding company's 42-item scorecard in 9 categories, so the choice could be compared side by side.
lines.- 地端元件排在離峰批次執行，不佔用營業時間的尖峰算力。: - The on-premises parts run as off-peak batches and take no peak business-hour compute.
lines.- 它是四個 Agent 裡用量最大的：每月 324,959 次登入，三年後預估: - It has the most use of the four Agents: 324,959 logins per month, forecast to reach 495,000 in year 3.
lines.- 它的 API 也是 Guardrails PoC 的測試對象：10 個業務領: - Its API was also tested in the Guardrails PoC: 1,100 cases across 10 business areas.

lines.- 完成算力池模型與尖峰估算，以及給四家廠商的資料索取表。: - The GPU pool model, the peak estimate, and a data request form for four vendors.
lines.- 客製化 Policy 在特定業務場景有效：1,500 題的漏放率從 10.2: - Custom Policies work for specific business scenarios: on 1,500 cases, the miss rate fell from 10.2% to 2.2%. General governance rules barely helped: on 1,000 cases it moved only from 21.1% to 20.0%.
lines.- 平台內建的防護，早已全數擋下同一批攻擊題。XecGuard 在 9 大構面評: - The platform's built-in guardrail had already blocked all of the same attacks. XecGuard scored 62.5 / 100 on a 9-dimension scorecard.
lines.- 建立四大 Agent 三年 TCO、TBE 與 ROI 的比較表格式。每個: - A 3-year TCO, TBE, and ROI comparison format for the 4 Agents. Each Agent's estimate is in the sub-projects below.
lines.- 建議把這套機制寫進「人工智慧技術生命週期管理要點」的一章：進入 SIT／UA: - Proposed adding this as a chapter of the bank's AI lifecycle rules: it starts at SIT / UAT, and no check report means no production release.
lines.- 未來若要統一管理多個 AI 平台，再把 XecGuard 列為候選廠商。: - If the bank later manages many AI platforms in one place, XecGuard can be a candidate vendor.
lines.- 機制可以沿用：新的 AI 專案只要填兩件事，這顆 AI 的規則，以及業務場景: - It is reusable: a new AI project fills in only two things, its rules and its business test set.
lines.- 漏放案例顯示，內容護欄管得住「說了什麼」，管不住「做了什麼」，例如工具呼叫與: - The missed cases show that content guardrails control what the AI says, not what it does, such as tool calls and transactions. That belongs at the AI Gateway layer.
lines.- 為其餘三個 Agent 建立版本化題庫。: - Build versioned test sets for the other three Agents.
lines.- 第一顆（貸款助理）把框架與測法建起來，之後每一顆只要填自己的規則與測試集。: - The first Agent (Loan Assistant) sets up the framework and test methods; each later Agent adds only its own rules and test set.
lines.- 訂出驗收門檻：UNSAFE 的阻擋率與 SAFE 的誤擋率。: - Set acceptance thresholds for the UNSAFE block rate and the SAFE false-block rate.
lines.- 試行信度評估的 ICC 是 0.759。: - The pilot reliability test gave an ICC of 0.759.
lines.A2UI 的技術研究，會先從智富管家的業務場景開始。: The A2UI research will start its business scenarios with the Wealth Assistant.
lines.A2UI 讓 Agent 直接產生使用者介面：Agent 不只回答一段文字，還能: A2UI lets an Agent generate the user interface: it does not only answer in text, it builds a screen for the situation. The bank wants to know if this works for wealth management, for example in the Wealth Assistant.
lines.AI 落地最難的部分，往往是「定義什麼是好的回答」。和業務端反覆對焦需求，花的時: The hardest part of putting AI to work is often defining what a good answer is. Aligning with the business side took more time than code, and it is where the real value is. My full write-up (in Chinese): [Lessons from building a RAG support bot](posts/rag-smart-customer-service.html).
lines.ESG 已經是投資界的共同語言，但 ESG 用在股票投資上，到底有沒有效益？這是: ESG is now a shared language in investing, but does ESG add value in stock investing? That was the question for that year's final project. Fubon has run the program with 5 universities for 7 years; NTUST joined for the first time.
lines.ESG 風險評分是投資人評估公司的一項指標。我想回答的問題是：**ESG 風險評: Investors use ESG risk scores as one measure of a company. My question: **do ESG risk scores affect the capital structure of Taiwanese companies?**
lines.Multi-Agent 系統最大的挑戰，不是讓每個 Agent 變聰明，而是設計: The biggest challenge in a multi-agent system is not making each Agent smarter. It is the protocol between them: who speaks first, who decides, and how conflicts are resolved. That design sets the system's ceiling. More details (in Chinese): [A Multi-Agent investment architecture](posts/multi-agent-investment.html).
lines.TEJ 的會員常常要查技術手冊與資料庫的使用方式。答案其實都在手冊裡，只是分散在: TEJ members often look up technical manuals and database usage. The answers are in the manuals but spread across them; when members cannot find one, they wait for support.
lines.TMBA 程式交易部每屆都要開發交易策略，並在期末成果發表中評比。一個策略要被認: Each TMBA algorithmic trading cohort develops strategies and presents them at a final showcase. A strategy is only taken seriously if it is repeatable and measurable: the same data must give the same result, and risk and return must be measured the same way.
lines.一個人做投資決策容易有盲點，所以基金公司會設置不同角色的分析師。單一 LLM 也: One person making investment decisions has blind spots, so fund companies use analysts with different roles. A single LLM is similar: it struggles to handle technicals, news sentiment, and fundamentals at once, and its advice has no reasoning trail to check. What if AI split the work too?
lines.三門全英課程的教學助理。: Teaching assistant for three English-taught courses.
lines.協作。我負責用 Whisper 建立影音的自動化處理與摘要流程。: Contributor. I built the automated processing and summary flow with Whisper.

lines.四大 Agent 需要一個平台來建置與管理，候選的是 Agatha 和開源的 D: The four Agents need a platform to build and manage them. The candidates were Agatha and the open-source Dify. A wrong choice is expensive: you find a missing capability halfway through, or a security gap after launch. I had to find the risks with real tests before purchase.
lines.四大業務服務 Agent 準備上線，銀行得決定 GPU 怎麼分、預算怎麼編。問題: The four business AI Agents were getting ready to launch, and the bank had to decide how to split GPUs and budgets. But their costs look completely different: some use on-premises GPUs, some use cloud tokens, one uses only CPUs. Without a shared model, they cannot be compared, and nobody can decide who gets resources first.
lines.四顆 Agent 準備上線。金管會的六大原則寫得很清楚：治理與問責、公平、隱私、: The four Agents were getting ready to launch. The FSC's six principles are clear: accountability, fairness, privacy, robustness and security, transparency and explainability, sustainability. But nobody could say clearly how to check them.
lines.四顆 Agent 的類型不同，第二層要換測法：對話型出題測回答；判斷型用已知答案: The four Agents are different types, so the second layer changes method: conversational AI is tested with questions; decision AI with cases that have known answers, for accuracy and consistency across groups; generative AI by sampling output against the source; scoring AI against human scores. One pass rule is shared: **zero critical errors**. Leaking another person's data, giving a loan decision directly, being led to change behavior, or taking an unauthorized action fails at once.
lines.回測期間與具體的報酬率、夏普值、最大回撤數字，待補充。: Backtest period and the return, Sharpe ratio, and drawdown figures: to be added.
lines.奧義科技的 XecGuard 是候選方案。廠商的報告很漂亮，但它測的不是凱基的業: CyCraft's XecGuard was the candidate. The vendor's report looked good, but it did not test KGI's business. So the PoC answered one question: **can it block attacks aimed at KGI, without blocking customers' normal questions?**
lines.客服助理（Service Agent）處理客服電話：地端先用 STT 把語音轉成: The Customer Service Agent handles service calls: on premises, STT turns speech into text, then an SLM processes it. Speech recognition is one of the heaviest GPU loads, and calls come during business hours. A wrong estimate means congestion at peak time.

lines.我再拆檢查局的八項查核事項，發現它們只問三件事：上線前評估過嗎？留下紀錄了嗎？上: I then took apart the examiners' eight inspection items and found they ask only three questions: was it assessed before launch? Are records kept? Is it still managed after launch? Three layers times three questions make nine cells.

lines.數位發展部推動「[數位青年 T 大使](https://moda.gov.tw/: Taiwan's Ministry of Digital Affairs runs the [Digital Youth T-Ambassador program](https://moda.gov.tw/ADI/industry-counseling/digital-service/4093) (page in Chinese) with two goals: digital inclusion, and filling talent gaps in industry. Rural organizations and SMEs lack digital and AI talent, so they find it hard to adopt generative AI on their own.
lines.智富管家是本行的 AI 理財助理 App（App 2.0）。上線前有兩個問題要先: The Wealth Assistant is the bank's AI wealth management app (App 2.0). Two questions came before launch: does Q&A work? And will the GPUs be enough as usage grows?
lines.智能徵審（Credit Agent）處理信用審查文件。案件量每年成長：目前每月: Credit Review (Credit Agent) handles credit review documents. Case volume grows every year: 13,513 cases per month today, 18,480 forecast in year 3. A budget based on today's cost will be wrong next year. I had two questions: what does one case cost, and what is the 3-year total?
lines.本行推動員工使用生成式 AI，但只發工具不夠：員工不知道哪些工作適合交給 AI，: The bank encourages employees to use generative AI, but tools alone are not enough: employees do not know which tasks suit AI, or how to use it safely. So this course answers "how do I use it in my work", not "what features does the tool have".
lines.東海大學開設以英文授課的商管核心課程。學生要用英文學習統計、經濟與財務管理，需要: Tunghai University teaches core business courses in English. Students learning statistics, economics, and financial management in English need a teaching assistant.
lines.法說會是公司對外說明營運與展望的時刻。事件交易策略要回答的問題是：這個事件，能不: An earnings call is when a company explains its operations and outlook. An event trading strategy asks one question: does this event give a signal you can trade?
lines.研究員每天要從券商報告、總經資料和新聞裡收集、整理資訊，才能開始做研究。Weba: Researchers had to collect and organize broker reports, macro data, and news every day before they could start research. Webai Finance is the AI Market Assistant and AI Stock Assistant in Kinance: the user picks a market or a stock, the AI answers from organized data, and the user can keep asking.
lines.研究團隊需要法說會的文字內容與重點。過去要有人逐場聽打影音，再整理重點，非常耗時: The research team needs the text and key points of earnings calls. Someone used to transcribe each video by hand and then summarize it, which took a long time.

lines.策略的進出場邏輯、回測期間與績效，待補充。: Entry and exit rules, backtest period, and results: to be added.

lines.課後統計兩個數字：參訓人數，以及課後提出的 AI 應用場景數。: After the course, count two numbers: attendees, and AI use cases proposed after class.
lines.財務報表裡有大量的文字與數字，但研究常用的財務比率，只能解釋一小部分的股價報酬變: Financial statements hold a lot of text and numbers, but the financial ratios research usually uses explain only a small part of stock return variance. My question: **can a large language model extract stronger signals from financial statements?**
lines.貸款助理（Sales Agent）協助客戶申辦貸款。要把它和其他三個 Agent: The Loan Assistant (Sales Agent) helps customers apply for loans. To compare it with the other three Agents on one baseline, the first step is to know which resources it uses.
lines.輔導企業的數量、產業與具體成果，待補充。: Number of companies, industries, and specific results: to be added.
lines.這套檢核接在既有流程的「風險評鑑」之後、「核准」之前，共五個步驟：判定要不要做: The check sits after "risk assessment" and before "approval", in five steps: decide if it applies → set this AI's rules → prepare the test set → test it → submit the report. No pass, no launch. Only business units can answer step two: how far may the Loan Assistant negotiate? What share of Credit Review cases need a human? May the Wealth Assistant touch transactions? Clear business rules are what let guardrails block the right things.
lines.這是團隊專案，也是我實習的第一個專案。我負責 RAG 架構、向量資料庫，以及前後: A team project and my first internship project. I owned the RAG architecture, the vector database, and the front end and admin console end to end.
lines.這是我在臺科大財務金融研究所的碩士論文，指導教授是周志隆與謝劍平教授。: This is my master's thesis at NTUST's Graduate Institute of Finance, advised by Professors Chih-Lung Chou and Joseph C.P. Shieh.
lines.這篇論文把 RAG 與 LLM 用在金融資料上，再用統計方法驗證結果。這也是我在: The thesis applies RAG and LLMs to financial data and checks the results with statistics. That is also how I work: build the system, then prove with data that it works.
lines.通過 Checkpoint 後，從智富管家的場景開始實作。: After the checkpoint, start with the Wealth Assistant's scenarios.
lines.量化上線後的效果，例如研究員每天整理資料的時間。: Measure the effect after launch, for example researchers' daily data-prep time.
lines.量測每份報告的審查時間，比較導入前後的差異。: Measure review time per report before and after the system.
lines.量測每場法說會的整理時間，比較自動化前後的差異。: Measure preparation time per call before and after automation.
lines.金控的集團 AI 統籌小組，要審查各子公司提交的 AI 使用報告：內容合不合理、: The group AI committee reviews AI usage reports from every subsidiary: is the content reasonable, is the risk level right, does it match the asset register? Manual review of each report was slow, and reviewers did not apply the same standard.
lines.金管會推動金融業專用的大型語言模型 FinLLM，凱基參與其中的資料清洗與模型評: Taiwan's FSC leads FinLLM, a large language model for the financial industry; KGI takes part in data cleaning and model evaluation. A model learns from its data: if the data is wrong, the model learns the errors, and in finance an error can also break regulations. So every item is handled one by one; there is no shortcut.
lines.銀行正準備導入四大業務服務 Agent。金管會的 AI 指引要求我們證明 AI: The bank was preparing to launch four business AI Agents. Taiwan's FSC AI guidelines require us to show that AI is fair, protects privacy, is secure, and is transparent (principles 2 to 5). Policy documents could prove that the process was followed. They could not prove that the AI's output was safe.
